mapper.sql: source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.company_id, source.source_code, source.display_name, source.source_type, source.status, configuration.endpoint_kind, configuration.source_time_zone, configuration.page_size, configuration.rate_limit_per_minute, configuration.backoff_seconds, configuration.secret_reference_name, configuration.revision_number AS configuration_revision, configuration.effective_from, source.row_version, FALSE AS replayed
mapper.select: SELECT FROM attendance_source source JOIN attendance_source_config_revision configuration ON configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision candidate WHERE candidate.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id ORDER BY candidate.revision_number DESC, candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE source.company_id = #{companyId} AND source.source_code = #{sourceCode} AND source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_source source JOIN attendance_source_config_revision configuration ON configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision candidate WHERE candidate.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id AND candidate.effective_from <= #{at} ORDER BY candidate.revision_number DESC, candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND configuration.secret_reference_name = #{secretReferenceName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_ingestion_idempotency ( attendance_ingestion_idempotency_id, actor_id, operation_code, resource_type, resource_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, status, response_status, response_headers_json, response_body_json, created_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{idempotencyId}, #{principalId}, 'DELI_SOURCE_REGISTER', 'ATTENDANCE_SOURCE', #{sourceCode}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, 'STARTED', NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, NULL )

INSERT INTO attendance_source_config_revision ( source_config_revision_id, attendance_source_id, revision_number, endpoint_kind, source_time_zone, page_size, rate_limit_per_minute, backoff_seconds, secret_reference_name, adapter_settings_json, effective_from, supersedes_config_revision_id, snapshot_digest, change_reason, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{configurationRevisionId}, #{sourceId}, 1, 'DELI_EPLUS_CHECKIN_QUERY', #{command.sourceTimeZone}, #{command.pageSize}, #{command.rateLimitPerMinute}, #{command.backoffSeconds}, #{command.secretReferenceName}, JSON_OBJECT( 'personReferencePolicy', 'CONFIRMED_DELI_BINDING', 'forbiddenPayloadPolicy', 'DROP' ), #{createdAt}, NULL, #{snapshotDigest}, #{command.reason}, #{principalId}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_ingestion_idempotency SET status = 'COMPLETED_SUCCESS', response_status = 201, response_headers_json = JSON_OBJECT(), response_body_json = JSON_OBJECT('sourceId', #{sourceId}), completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE attendance_ingestion_idempotency_id = #{idempotencyId} AND status = 'STARTED'
mapper.select: SELECT source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.company_id, source.display_name, configuration.secret_reference_name, configuration.source_time_zone, configuration.page_size, configuration.rate_limit_per_minute, configuration.backoff_seconds, watermark.committed_cursor FROM attendance_source source JOIN attendance_source_config_revision configuration ON configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision candidate WHERE candidate.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id AND candidate.effective_from <= #{at} ORDER BY candidate.revision_number DESC, candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN attendance_sync_watermark watermark ON watermark.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id WHERE source.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND configuration.endpoint_kind = 'DELI_EPLUS_CHECKIN_QUERY' AND configuration.secret_reference_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_source other_source JOIN attendance_source_config_revision other_configuration ON other_configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT other_candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision other_candidate WHERE other_candidate.attendance_source_id = other_source.attendance_source_id AND other_candidate.effective_from <= #{at} ORDER BY other_candidate.revision_number DESC, other_candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE other_source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND other_source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND other_source.attendance_source_id <> source.attendance_source_id AND other_configuration.secret_reference_name = configuration.secret_reference_name ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability granted_capability ON granted_capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND granted_capability.capability_code = #{capability} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id AND data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = source.company_id WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role_assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND ( role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{at} ) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND ( data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at} ) ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.company_id, source.display_name, configuration.secret_reference_name, configuration.source_time_zone, configuration.page_size, configuration.rate_limit_per_minute, configuration.backoff_seconds, watermark.committed_cursor FROM attendance_source source JOIN attendance_source_config_revision configuration ON configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision candidate WHERE candidate.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id AND candidate.effective_from <= #{at} ORDER BY candidate.revision_number DESC, candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN attendance_sync_watermark watermark ON watermark.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id WHERE source.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND configuration.endpoint_kind = 'DELI_EPLUS_CHECKIN_QUERY' AND configuration.secret_reference_name IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT source.attendance_source_id FROM attendance_source source WHERE source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY source.attendance_source_id

SELECT job.attendance_sync_job_id AS original_job_id, job.status AS original_status, job.row_version AS original_row_version, source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.company_id, source.display_name, configuration.secret_reference_name, configuration.source_time_zone, configuration.page_size, configuration.rate_limit_per_minute, configuration.backoff_seconds, watermark.committed_cursor FROM attendance_sync_job job JOIN attendance_source source ON source.attendance_source_id = job.attendance_source_id JOIN attendance_source_config_revision configuration ON configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision candidate WHERE candidate.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id AND candidate.effective_from <= #{authorizationTime} ORDER BY candidate.revision_number DESC, candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN attendance_sync_watermark watermark ON watermark.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id WHERE job.attendance_sync_job_id = #{originalJobId} AND source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND configuration.endpoint_kind = 'DELI_EPLUS_CHECKIN_QUERY' AND configuration.secret_reference_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_source other_source JOIN attendance_source_config_revision other_configuration ON other_configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT other_candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision other_candidate WHERE other_candidate.attendance_source_id = other_source.attendance_source_id AND other_candidate.effective_from <= #{authorizationTime} ORDER BY other_candidate.revision_number DESC, other_candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE other_source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND other_source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND other_source.attendance_source_id <> source.attendance_source_id AND other_configuration.secret_reference_name = configuration.secret_reference_name ) AND FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_ingestion_idempotency ( attendance_ingestion_idempotency_id, actor_id, operation_code, resource_type, resource_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, status, response_status, response_headers_json, response_body_json, created_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{idempotencyId}, #{principalId}, 'DELI_SOURCE_RETRY', 'ATTENDANCE_SYNC_JOB', #{originalJobId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, 'STARTED', NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_ingestion_idempotency SET status = 'COMPLETED_SUCCESS', response_status = 200, response_headers_json = JSON_OBJECT(), response_body_json = JSON_OBJECT('jobId', #{newJobId}), completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE attendance_ingestion_idempotency_id = #{idempotencyId} AND status = 'STARTED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_sync_job WHERE attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_sync_job job SET job.status = 'FAILED', job.safe_error_code = 'DELI_SYNC_LEASE_EXPIRED', job.finished_at = #{finishedAt}, job.row_version = job.row_version + 1 WHERE job.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND job.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND COALESCE( ( SELECT MAX(page.committed_at) FROM attendance_sync_job_page page WHERE page.attendance_sync_job_id = job.attendance_sync_job_id ), job.started_at, job.created_at ) < #{staleBefore}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_sync_watermark ( attendance_source_id, committed_cursor, committed_page_digest, row_version, committed_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attendance_source_id = attendance_source_id

INSERT INTO attendance_sync_job ( attendance_sync_job_id, attendance_source_id, requested_watermark, status, started_at, finished_at, page_count, accepted_count, quarantined_count, safe_error_code, correlation_id, row_version, requested_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{jobId}, #{sourceId}, #{requestedWatermark}, 'QUEUED', NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, #{correlationId}, 0, #{requestedBy}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_sync_job SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{startedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_sync_job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE attendance_sync_job SET status = 'FAILED', safe_error_code = #{safeErrorCode}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_sync_job_id = #{jobId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE attendance_sync_job SET status = #{status}, safe_error_code = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_sync_job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIALLY_QUARANTINED')
mapper.select: SELECT job.attendance_sync_job_id AS job_id, source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.company_id, job.status AS job_status, job.page_count AS committed_pages, watermark.committed_cursor, watermark.row_version AS watermark_version FROM attendance_sync_job job JOIN attendance_source source ON source.attendance_source_id = job.attendance_source_id JOIN attendance_sync_watermark watermark ON watermark.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id WHERE job.attendance_sync_job_id = #{jobId} AND source.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND job.status = 'RUNNING' AND FOR UPDATE

SELECT job.attendance_sync_job_id AS job_id, source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.company_id, job.status AS job_status, job.page_count AS committed_pages, watermark.committed_cursor, watermark.row_version AS watermark_version FROM attendance_sync_job job JOIN attendance_source source ON source.attendance_source_id = job.attendance_source_id JOIN attendance_sync_watermark watermark ON watermark.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id WHERE job.attendance_sync_job_id = #{jobId} AND source.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND job.status = 'RUNNING' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_sync_watermark SET committed_cursor = #{committedCursor}, committed_page_digest = #{pageDigest}, committed_at = #{committedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE attendance_sync_job SET page_count = page_count + 1, accepted_count = accepted_count + #{acceptedCount}, quarantined_count = quarantined_count + #{quarantinedCount}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_sync_job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
